title: Munitions replenishment: the delivery schedule is set at motors, energetics, metal parts and seekers, not at the primes
map_limitation: Supplier-side EDGAR full-text search reaches only part of this chain: four of the eight links that carry tickers name non-SEC filers (BA.L, RHM.DE, 012450.KS, AVIO.MI), and the deepest four links (nitration-feedstocks, nozzle-ablatives, load-assemble-pack, dod-munitions-procurement) carry no example tickers at all because every operator the cited sources name at those stages is either a government plant (Holston, Radford, Iowa Army Ammunition Plant, Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head) or a private firm (Repkon USA, Eurenco, Poland's Nitro-Chem, Nammo, Anduril, X-Bow, Ursa Major, Firehawk, Castelion, Prometheus Energetics). Government-owned contractor-operated capacity is unreachable through a brokerage account and is separated out here rather than assumed away. Four further limits to carry forward. First, ticker collision: BA on this map is Boeing (PAC-3 MSE radar seeker) and BA.L is BAE Systems plc (THAAD infrared seeker, Holston operator); they are different issuers on two links. Second, the map cannot state content per interceptor: no cited source discloses what fraction of an interceptor's price lands at the motor, the seeker or the energetics, so the chain shows sequence and scarcity, not dollar shares. Third, the depletion figures that motivate the occurrence are analyst and official estimates, not audited inventory counts, so the demand side is directionally sourced and quantitatively soft. Fourth, and against the thesis this map was built to test: CSIS says explicitly that ammonium perchlorate, the most-cited single point of failure, is NOT currently the binding constraint because AMPAC's capacity outpaces demand by a significant margin. That link is mapped as HIGH rather than CHOKE_POINT on the strength of its own source.

links.role: The commodity chemistry every military explosive and propellant is nitrated from: ammonia and nitric acid, acetic acid and acetic anhydride, and the cotton linters or wood pulp that become nitrocellulose, a plane where the largest producers sit in Asia rather than in the countries doing the replenishing.

impact.rationale: The occurrence pulls on this plane without straining it. Military nitration draws on ammonia, nitric and acetic acid and cellulose, which are world commodity markets where defence offtake is a rounding error, so the exposure the sources describe is where the capacity sits rather than how much of it there is. Modern War Institute puts the mechanism plainly: other countries' chemical industries can now set the ceiling on how fast any country's munitions base can move, and Europe's cellulose feedstock has run through cotton linters sourced from Asia. That is a geopolitical speed limit, not a volume squeeze, and it acts on the link one and two steps downstream before it acts here. Scored between the touched-and-diversified-away anchor and clearly-moved.

notes.text: Thesis test, stated plainly because the map was built to test it rather than decorate it. The claim was that the choke point sits one and two tiers upstream of the primes. It does, but not evenly, and one of the four named candidates fails its own evidence. CONFIRMED as CHOKE_POINT with dated sources: solid rocket motors (six domestic suppliers to two between 2000 and 2015), projectile metal parts and forgings (named by Defense News as the limiting factor, with a $469 million purpose-built plant producing no conforming parts), seekers (one Boeing facility for every PAC-3 MSE radar seeker, 650 to 700 delivered in 2025), and energetic materials (one US RDX site, seven years to make an energetics line worker fully effective). NOT CONFIRMED: ammonium perchlorate. CSIS states that reliance on AMPAC alone is not currently a bottleneck because capacity outpaces demand by a significant margin, so it is mapped HIGH, as a disruption and price-setting risk, not as the gate. A map that had scored it CHOKE_POINT because the phrase sole source appears in the coverage would have been wrong on its best available source.

Crowdedness caution for the heat stage, recorded as a structural observation and not as a score. Solid rocket motors are the most cited bottleneck in this whole corpus of sources: CSIS wrote a report about it, SpaceNews and Breaking Defense covered that report, and the Pentagon announced a $3bn framework whose stated purpose is to widen it. That is the definition of a discovered constraint. The links that no fetched source treats as a story in itself are nozzle ablatives (rayon, where the supply problem is that defence demand alone cannot keep a commercial line open), nondestructive inspection and requalification (the mechanism that converts one supplier loss into a multi-year delay), and load, assemble and pack. Two of those three carry no listed exposure at all, which is itself the finding rather than a gap in the search.

Source dating note. The CSIS report cover shows JUNE 2026 with no day. The day used here, 2026-06-12, is taken from the publication's own filename on the CSIS server (260612_Rumbaugh_Rocket_Motors.pdf) rather than invented. The BAE Systems Holston article is dated 2013-01-05 and is cited only for the operator relationship and the product list, both of which the 2026 Modern War Institute piece independently corroborates for the single-site RDX claim. Two sources considered and NOT cited: the U.S. Army newsroom release on the domestic TNT contract returns HTTP 403, and CNBC's Rheinmetall propellant piece returns HTTP 403, so neither is evidence here and the TNT dependence claim rests on the Modern War Institute's Nitro-Chem contract figure instead.

Archetypes applied, from data/chains/_archetypes.md. ARCH-001 (precision manufacturing capacity as the gating step) fires twice and is the spine of this map: metal-parts-and-forgings and nondestructive-inspection are both capacity-and-qualification gates rather than product links. ARCH-003 (the uninvestable order-book owner) fires on dod-munitions-procurement, zero tickers, CHOKE_POINT, never the trade and always the schedule. ARCH-004 (critical material input, criticality set by substitutability times logistics) fires three times, on perchlorate-oxidizer, nozzle-ablatives and nitration-feedstocks, and its instruction to record both inputs is what kept ammonium perchlorate off CHOKE_POINT. ARCH-006 (geopolitical counter-response as a first-class link) fires on allied-rearmament-demand, wired in as a second sink competing for the same energetics and motors rather than left as narrative; the archetype library flags this one as the corpus's most likely systematic miss, and on this chain it is where the non-US exposure lives. ARCH-002 (EPC volume without capture) was CHECKED and does NOT fire: there is no competitively bid construction link on this map, and the closest analogue, load-assemble-pack, is government plant capacity rather than contractor volume. ARCH-007 (the semis layer as a leaf) was CHECKED and deliberately NOT included: GaN and RF microelectronics sit behind the radars that cue these interceptors, but no source fetched for this map ties a semiconductor constraint to the replenishment schedule, and an uncited link added to reach a round number is exactly what the citation bar exists to stop. ARCH-005 (power and grid equipment) does not apply to this occurrence.

explainer.shape: זו לא שרשרת בקו ישר אלא צורה שמתפצלת ומתאחדת: הכל מתחיל בכימיה גולמית משותפת, שמתפצלת לחומר נפץ מצד אחד ולחומר החמצון של מנוע הרקטה מצד שני, לצד חומר הבידוד וגוף המתכת. שני הזרמים נפגשים שוב בייצור מנוע הרקטה המוצקה, עוברים בדיקה ומילוי, ומגיעים להרכבה הסופית של הטילים והפגזים. במקום קצה אחד יש כאן שניים: הביקוש הצבאי האמריקאי עצמו, וביקוש נפרד של צבאות בעלות ברית שמושך בדיוק על אותם חומרים נדירים.
explainer.thesis: התזה של המפה הזאת היא שהעיכוב האמיתי בחימוש מחדש לא יושב אצל שלוש חברות ההרכבה הגדולות שכל הכותרות עוסקות בהן, אלא חוליה או שתיים מעליהן: מנוע הרקטה המוצקה, חלקי המתכת, החיישנים וחומר הנפץ עצמו. אבל למפה הזאת אין פינת כסף אחת ברורה: החוליות החונקות באמת כבר מוגלות מאוד בשוק, בעוד שהחוליות השקטות באמת הן כאלה שאין בהן שום חברה נסחרת לקנות, כי הן ממשלתיות או שהשוק האזרחי נטש אותן. גילוי אחד מפתיע וסותר את החשד המקורי: החומר שהכי מדברים עליו כנקודת כשל בודדת, חומר החמצון של המנוע, מתברר שהיצרן שלו מייצר הרבה יותר ממה שמבוקש כרגע, כך שהסיכון האמיתי שם הוא הפרעה ותמחור, לא מחסור בפועל.
